vehicle_state: independent position, remaining capacity, available time per vehicle
first_stage_fleet_use: all m vehicles receive a nonempty route when at least m requests are visible
terminal_dispatch: complete static closure at 480 after ten regular intervals
depot_return: at most once per active interval; capacity restored only at physical return
cost_definition: sum of committed customer edges with start < boundary plus one physical depot return for each active vehicle/interval; unstarted planned suffixes are not charged
